header: A list of files to take away
lead: One to twenty rows at two, three or four across. Each row is a single link target, so a reader aiming at it on a phone does not have to hit the four words of the title exactly.
note: The format and size live in the row's own description, where an editor can keep them true — nothing on the page can read the size of a file that sits on another server.
